review_kind: Independent technical source review; reviewer did not author bridge source/prose.
verified_contracts: make_thread creates its QThread, moves the worker, connects started, registers RunHandle and returns the pair without starting the thread.
RunHandle.retire is connected to thread.finished; it clears worker/thread references and unregisters the handle. A retained registry entry is not proof of current execution.
PipelineWorker.finished requests thread.quit directly before QThread completion; describing retirement by thread.finished preserves actual ordering.

The existing user_visible argument is copied to worker then RunHandle and filtered by activity_spinner; the wording deliberately promises filtering only in displays honoring that flag. It does not cancel work.
RunRegistry.active returns retained handles without querying thread state.
